summary: The filing is an 8-K by Erasca, Inc. disclosing a conference call for preliminary Phase 1 data on ERAS-0015 (Item 7.01) and a cease-and-desist letter from Revolution Medicines alleging patent infringement and trade secret misappropriation (Item 8.01). This is a routine disclosure of a legal dispute, not a special situation like an acquisition or restructuring. No deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes are present. The event is a regulatory update on litigation, not a transformative corporate action.
